span.label: mechanisms
span.term: three independent methods are run over the same arcs - matrix decomposition, hierarchical clustering and an unsupervised self-organising map - and the paper states that confirmation comes only from the three supporting each other
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the emotional arc is separated from the plot by construction: it is what the words invoke, and the paper says the same arc can arise from very different plots
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the sliding-window construction itself is described in a different sentence and in the Figure 1 caption, not in this span; the window size is unquotable here because the extraction stores its digits as private-use glyphs (Q-595)
span.term: the paper states plainly that the dictionary method it relies on performs WORSE THAN RANDOM on an individual sentence, which is why the instrument is never applied at sentence level
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the arcs are mean-centred before decomposition so that the first mode is not spent on the average sentiment or on the positivity bias of language
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: clusters are built by Ward's method, which the paper describes as proceeding by minimising variance between clusters
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: conflation of several arcs in one book is limited by restricting the corpus to shorter books, a filter chosen for that purpose
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Success is measured only by Project Gutenberg download counts.
span.note: what this limits: the success analysis only: DOWNLOADS ARE ONLY A ROUGH PROXY FOR SUCCESS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The sliding-window method cannot detect briefly mentioned emotional events.
span.note: what this limits: the resolution of every arc: OUR METHOD DOES NOT PICK UP EMOTIONAL MOMENTS DISCUSSED BRIEFLY, PERHAPS IN ONE PARAGRAPH OR SENTENCE (E.G., THE FIRST KISS OF HARRY AND GINNY)
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: An emotional arc is not the plot and does not identify it.
span.note: what this limits: any narrative reading of the arcs: an emotional arc is not the plot and does not identify it
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Only shorter books were analysed, to avoid conflating several core arcs.
span.note: what this limits: the corpus the arcs were derived from: TO LIMIT THE CONFLATION OF MULTIPLE CORE EMOTIONAL ARCS, WE RESTRICT OUR ANALYSIS TO SHORTER BOOKS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The sentiment tool is stated to perform worse than random on individual sentences, and is made usable only by averaging over a rolling window.
span.note: what this limits: any sentence-level or short-passage reading of these sentiment scores: the authors state that dictionary-based sentiment methods usually perform worse than random on individual sentences, and the arcs are built from a rolling average instead
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The result is what three different methods agree on; the paper says no single tool establishes it.
span.note: what this limits: the six-arc finding: it is confirmed only by considering the results of each tool in support of the others - a matrix decomposition, a hierarchical clustering and an unsupervised map - so a citation of 'six basic shapes' that drops the three-method agreement drops the evidence
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Two of the six decomposition modes are retained for completeness and are stated not to match the archetypes the other methods produce.
span.note: what this limits: the six SVD modes as six arcs: the paper says the high-frequency modes contribute little variance and do not align with the core archetypes recovered by the other methods, and are included only for completeness
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: sentiment analysis applied to works of fiction to extract their emotional arcs

span.label: every method re-run at four different DOWNLOAD-COUNT thresholds. THE NUMERALS SURVIVE EXTRACTION AS PRIVATE-USE-AREA GLYPHS (U+F639, U+F63C ...) rather than digits, so the thresholds are present in the text and unreadable; they are quoted as they stand and not guessed
span.note: eliminates: the popularity cut-off as the source of the emotional-arc findings - a corpus filtered by downloads is a corpus of what people read, and an arc shape could be a property of the filter rather than of literature · outcome: held
